Tuesday Graton Car-Free Shoot Guide (Mark and Andy)

Follow these 20 cards across six stops on Tuesday, November 10, with Mark filming most shots on the DJI camera.

Works on the 10:10 AM ferry after 8:00 AM outdoor French breakfast, or the 11:50 AM and 12:35 PM boats.

Every movement card shows the camera move or frame entry post cannot make; grab two takes per setup.

Before you go
  • Move in or arc mid-shot.
  • Let riders enter and leave.
  • Film two takes and angles.
  • Count three before and after.
Boats: 10:10 (8:00 AM French spot), 11:50, 12:35.
Sunny 66-76F; warm light 4:25, sunset 5:03 PM.
Rain plan: film inside boat, train, room.
Running late: skip Should cards.

Setup 1: Rehearsal and SF Ride

Southeast sun; 8:00 AM French patio fits 10:10 ferry.

1 · Run 10-minute camera and mic test
MustMark Pocket 4 + MicsMonday test · Outside, 5ft away · record 30s
MoreSet 3K 60fps 9:16, Grid on, Audio Backup on, windscreens on. Film wide, medium, close (10s each), check on earphones, and upload to Drive.
2 · Click ebike power on
MustMark Pocket 4SF start · Bottom grid, 16in · record 10s
Say: “I am between jobs this Tuesday.”
MoreOptional 8:00 AM outdoor French breakfast fits the 10:10 AM ferry. Hold 5 seconds still, then move camera in on display for a second take.
3 · Track Andy, let him pass
MustMark Pocket 4Embarcadero path · Low, 8ft ahead · record 12s
Say: “Graton comped my room, so Mark brought his cameras.”
MoreDouble-tap Andy for ActiveTrack. Shoot two takes: follow behind, then let Andy ride out of frame. Cross rails at 90 degrees; no handlebar mounts (DJI).
4 · Walk in, tilt up tower
ShouldMark Pocket 4Ferry Plaza · Crosswalk, eye level · record 10s
Say: “We ebike down Market Street to Gate C.”
MorePlant feet still. Let Andy walk his powered-off bike into the right third, then tilt up the tower. Keep drone packed at plaza (SF Port).

Setup 2: Ferry Gate C and Bay Crossing

Boats at 10:10, 11:50, 12:35; sun behind Mark.

5 · Tap Gate C Clipper
MustMark Pocket 4Gate C · Bottom grid, 16in · record 10s
Say: “The 12:35 Larkspur ferry costs 9.50.”
MoreSay 10:10, 11:50, or 12:35 to match your boat; gates close 1 minute prior (Golden Gate Ferry). Film one static take and one push-in take.
6 · Wipe railing, push in
ShouldMark Pocket 4Boarding ramp · Eye level, 6ft · record 12s
Say: “Ebikes under 50 pounds ride free, powered off.”
MoreStart behind a railing, walk heel-to-toe pushing in, then let Andy leave frame. Arrive 20 minutes early for the 30-bike rack (Golden Gate Ferry).
7 · Move in, arc to wake
MustMark Pocket 4Rear deck · Eye level, 5ft · record 15s
Say: “Can you reach Graton Casino from San Francisco car free?”
MoreAlso say: Welcome to part one of casinos without cars. Film two takes: one moving in on Andy, one arcing to the Ferry Building wake.
8 · Clink beers in grid
MustMark Pocket 4Upper deck · Eye level, 4ft · record 12s
Say: “The boat has a bar, so cheers.”
MoreLet your laugh run, then record 20 quiet seconds of Bay wake. Max 2 snack-bar drinks per ID; no outside alcohol (Golden Gate Ferry).

Setup 3: Larkspur Bridge and Country Mart

Docks 10:45, 12:25, 1:10; open patio shade.

9 · Lead on bridge, let pass
ShouldMark Pocket 4Larkspur bridge · Low, 6ft ahead · record 12s
Say: “This footbridge leads straight into Marin Country Mart.”
MoreAlso say your arrival time (10:45, 12:25, or 1:10). Walk heel-to-toe, then stop so Andy leaves frame. Keep drone packed near marsh (CDFW).
10 · Slide past bikes to plate
MustMark Pocket 4Patio table · High, 20in away · record 10s
Say: “We grab tacos with our bikes in sight.”
MoreLe Marais Bistro (French, 8:00 AM) and El Huarache Loco (8:00 AM) have bike-rack patios; Hog Island opens 11:30 AM. Shoot slide-in and static takes.

Setup 4: SMART Train and Switch 2 Zelda

Trains 11:52, 2:00, 3:04; sit east side.

11 · Tap SMART Clipper reader
MustMark Pocket 4Larkspur platform · Bottom grid, 16in · record 10s
Say: “The train costs 4.50: 14 total.”
MoreMatch your Gate C hand framing in the lower-third grid box. Film a second take pushing in on the reader as Andy walks onto platform.
12 · Train arrival and bike hooks
ShouldMark Pocket 4Train doors · Low behind line · record 15s
Say: “We hang both bikes on the train car hooks.”
MoreRoll before train enters frame, then board and film Andy lifting his bike onto the vertical hook (max 12 bikes/car, kickstand up, no alcohol, SMART).
13 · Plug into seat outlet
MustMark Pocket 4East seat · Bottom grid, 18in · record 10s
Say: “Because nobody is driving a car,”
MoreFrame right hand plugging into AC outlet and clicking Switch 2 in lower grid. Only personal electronics allowed in outlets, never ebike batteries (SMART).
14 · Play Zelda by east window
MustMark Pocket 4Northbound train · Across east aisle · record 15s
Say: “I play the new Ocarina of Time through wine country.”
MoreSit on east (right) side to beat west sun glare, set Switch 2 to 100% brightness, lock exposure, and also film one over-the-shoulder push-in take.

Setup 5: Rohnert Park and Labath Auto-Drone

Arrives 12:50, 2:58, 4:02; fly before 5:03 sunset.

15 · Tap off Clipper at exit
MustMark Pocket 4Rohnert Park · Bottom grid, 16in · record 10s
Say: “We tap off at Rohnert Park.”
MoreAlso say: A creek path ducks right under Highway 101. Tapping off saves the $3 penalty (SMART). Film a second take riding out of frame.
16 · Auto Takeoff and ActiveTrack ride
MustMark Mini 5 ProLabath sidewalk · Solid ground, 15ft · record 20s
Say: “On Labath Avenue, Mark launches the drone in auto mode.”
MoreStop on flat pavement (Class G, 249.9g battery). Tap 9:16, Auto Takeoff, ActiveTrack Cycling for 15s, then Flight Pause, stop bikes, and Auto Landing (DJI).

Setup 6: Graton Arch, Room Door, and Slots

4:25 PM golden hour; LED fill inside room.

17 · Tilt arch, pocket both mics
MustMark Pocket 4Graton arch · Planted, 7ft · record 12s
Say: “Casino rule: mics go in our pockets, now for the bikes.”
MorePlant feet still, tilt down from sign to Andy, unclip mics into pockets, then let Andy wheel his bike out of frame (Graton Policy).
18 · Push in as door opens
MustMark Pocket 4Room door · Eye level, 4ft · record 15s
Say: “Moment of truth at our comped hotel room.”
MoreWalk heel-to-toe through the doorway into the 515-sq-ft room. If lobby staff stop bikes, check frames free at Bell Desk and charge batteries upstairs (Graton).
19 · Push in on spin button
MustAndy PhoneCasino floor · Handheld, 3ft · record 10s
Say: “Bikes secured, batteries charging, and one quick slot spin.”
MoreHandheld phone only with mics and gimbal pocketed. Keep other guests, staff, table games, and player cards out of frame (Graton Policy).
20 · Toast by room window
MustMark Pocket 4Comped room · Tabletop, 7ft · record 15s
Say: “50 miles, zero cars: comment which casino is next.”
MoreRe-clip both mics inside private room and add Mark's LED fill light. Also film one take moving camera around your toast for an alternate opener.
